statement: I can’t publish this deposit as open. Its access record says **open**, but the participant-level, coded data were consented for **access on request only**. The access record must be corrected to **restricted** before publication.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "Its access record says **open**, but the participant-level, coded data were consented for **access on request only**" and gives the correct value, restricted.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
